---
title: "Historical PRISM check of airport drought representativeness"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
p <- jsonlite::fromJSON("outputs/prism-manifest.json")
s <- read.csv("outputs/prism-station-check.csv")
```

The original PRISM archive contains daily precipitation and maximum temperature
for 2009–2018. This supplementary analysis recomputes KBDI over **`r p$cells`**
grid cells intersecting ANF, using `terra` instead of retired `rgdal` workflows.
It reads only the forest window, pairs the two variables by date, and uses
intersection-area weights. Missing precipitation is never silently set to zero.
Both station and grid calculations require one year of complete spin-up.

```{r map}
knitr::include_graphics("outputs/prism-anomaly-correspondence.png")
```

Area-weighted daily R² is **`r round(p$raw_r2_area_weighted, 2)`**. After removing
the shared calendar-day seasonal cycle, the area-weighted anomaly R² is
**`r round(p$anomaly_r2_area_weighted, 2)`**. These describe temporal correspondence;
they do not measure unbiased forest-wide drought or independent validation.
PRISM uses station observations. The short historical record cannot establish
spatial representativeness of the full long-term trend.

```{r summary}
knitr::kable(data.frame(Statistic=c("Raw R2", "Anomaly R2", "Bias (mm)", "RMSE (mm)"),
  AreaWeightedMean=c(weighted.mean(s$RawR2,s$AreaWeight), weighted.mean(s$AnomalyR2,s$AreaWeight),
    weighted.mean(s$MeanBiasMm,s$AreaWeight), weighted.mean(s$RMSEmm,s$AreaWeight))), digits=3)
```

The gridded observations have **not** been extended beyond 2018. A compact
extracted cache and a source inventory are saved in `Data/raw/`; the complete
continental archive is retained in `Data/PRISM/`. To rebuild the extraction,
run `Rscript scripts/prism-check.R --reextract`. The cache can reproduce this
check without rereading the continental archive. The historical notebook is
preserved in `archive/legacy/Gridded_KBDI.Rmd`.
